name: write-goal
description: Provider-neutral goal writing with observable proof and optional application adapters.

interface.shortDescription: A finish line you can prove
interface.longDescription: Write one measurable completion condition with observable proof, preserved constraints, and a stopping boundary. Use the AI-agnostic instructions as prompt context in your chosen assistant. Plain text is the shared default; native application integrations are optional.
defaultPrompt: Draft a measurable completion condition for my task.
Refine this goal without changing its constraints.
